name: ShopTrueProfit
summary: Profit reports for Etsy, eBay and Amazon sellers: upload your sales reports and see profit per order, product and month after fees and ads, processed in the browser.
best_for: Etsy sellers, and smaller eBay or Amazon sellers, who want to see profit per order and product after fees and ads, and prefer to keep their report files in the browser instead of connecting a store login
skip_if: your main store runs on Shopify or WooCommerce, you want a live connection to your marketplace account, or you want a product we have tested ourselves instead of one read from its public pages
honest_knock: eBay and Amazon support is labelled beta and cloud sync covers Etsy data only. Free shows only your latest month, so a real history needs a paid plan. The page shows dollar signs without a currency code, and the lifetime offer has no stated end date. It is not the Shopify product TrueProfit.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Monthly · Monthly $7 a month with cancel anytime
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on shoptrueprofit.com, dollar amounts as shown) ShopTrueProfit has three options. Free costs $0 and gives a full sample-data demo, your latest month, the Etsy, eBay and Amazon fee calculators, and files that stay in your browser. Monthly costs $7 a month and adds your full profit history, month, year-to-date, yearly and custom date ranges, comparison against the previous period, profit per order, product and month, ads return on spend, cloud sync and backup for Etsy data, and CSV exports; the page says you can cancel anytime. The Lifetime founding member offer is $59 one time, shown next to a struck-through $99, and includes everything in Monthly, all future updates and no subscription; the page says the discount is applied at checkout. Payments, receipts and sales tax are handled by Lemon Squeezy, and you get a license key by email. The page shows dollar signs without naming the currency. We did not buy a plan, so we do not know the tax added, when the founding price ends or what a refund looks like.
